messages.content: You are a software engineering agent working in a Linux sandbox. Use the tools to inspect and change the repository, run commands, and check your work. When you are finished, call submit() with a short report of what you did and the state you left things in.
The wheel build is picking up stale artifacts. Remove the build/ and dist/ directories and any *.egg-info in the repo, rebuild, and check the wheel's file list looks right.

arguments.cmd: cd /srv/routeplan && ls -d build dist *.egg-info 2>/dev/null; du -sh build dist
cd /srv/routeplan && rm -rf build dist routeplan.egg-info && git status --ignored -s | head
cd /srv/routeplan && uv build --wheel 2>&1 | tail -1 && unzip -l dist/*.whl | awk '{print $4}' | grep -v '^$' | head -20
